reason: Personalized normative feedback may change perceived descriptive norms, but the intervention bundles own behavior, prior perceived peer behavior and measured peer comparison. This route overlaps REL-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001 and cannot become an additive effect.
Source-label field evidence shows limited average outcome effects; exact noticed-label to source-credibility effect and source identity remain unresolved.
Narrative, vividness, emotion and exemplar packages do not isolate the proposed attentional-salience effect.
Tailoring and recipient relevance are not the same construct; multi-component tailoring packages do not isolate personalization's effect.
Repetition contribution is already represented by inactive Psychological Relationship and EffectAssertion under CONTRIB-PSY-LAYER-REPETITION-001. New effect would duplicate the same contribution.
